resep.ringkas_id: Dadu wagyu meltique dimasak cepat dengan saus lada hitam, matang di luar, juicy di dalam.
resep.ringkas_en: Meltique wagyu cubes seared fast in a black pepper sauce, crusted outside and juicy within.
bahan_id: 300 g Wagyu Meltique Beef Saikoro, suhu ruang 15 menit
bahan_en: 300 g Wagyu Meltique Beef Saikoro, rested 15 min at room temp
langkah_id: Keringkan permukaan daging dengan tisu, taburi sedikit garam.
Panaskan wajan sampai berasap. Panggang dadu daging 45 detik tiap sisi hingga kecokelatan. Angkat, sisihkan.
Kecilkan api, lelehkan mentega, tumis bawang putih sampai wangi.
Masukkan kecap asin, saus tiram, lada hitam, gula, dan air. Masak hingga saus mengental.
Kembalikan daging ke wajan, aduk cepat 30 detik agar terbalut saus. Sajikan panas.
langkah_en: Pat the beef dry with paper towel and season lightly with salt.
Heat a pan until smoking. Sear the cubes 45 seconds per side until browned. Remove and set aside.
Lower the heat, melt the butter, saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add soy sauce, oyster sauce, black pepper, sugar and water. Simmer until the sauce thickens.
Return the beef, toss quickly for 30 seconds to coat. Serve hot.

resep.ringkas_id: Brisket empuk dimasak perlahan dalam kuah kecap manis berrempah, cocok untuk nasi hangat.
resep.ringkas_en: Brisket slow-cooked until tender in a spiced sweet soy broth, made for a plate of warm rice.
bahan_id: 1 kg BZL Beef Brisket, potong kotak 4 cm
3 butir cengkih, 1 batang kayu manis, 1/2 buah pala
bahan_en: 1 kg BZL Beef Brisket, cut into 4 cm cubes
langkah_id: Rebus brisket dalam air mendidih 10 menit, buang busanya, tiriskan.
Tumis bumbu halus, bawang bombai, dan jahe hingga harum dan matang.
Masukkan cengkih, kayu manis, dan pala. Aduk 1 menit.
Masukkan daging, aduk rata, tuang kecap manis dan air.
Masak dengan api kecil tertutup 1,5 - 2 jam sampai daging empuk dan kuah menyusut. Cicipi, sesuaikan garam dan gula.
langkah_en: Boil the brisket in water for 10 minutes, skim the foam, drain.
Saute the ground spice paste, onion and ginger until fragrant and cooked.
Add cloves, cinnamon and nutmeg. Stir for 1 minute.
Add the beef, stir to coat, pour in the sweet soy sauce and water.
Cover and simmer on low for 1.5 - 2 hours until the beef is tender and the sauce reduces. Adjust salt and sugar.

resep.ringkas_id: Steak striploin Australia dengan kerak cokelat, mentega bawang putih, dan istirahat yang cukup.
resep.ringkas_en: Australian striploin steak with a brown crust, garlic butter, and a proper rest.
langkah_id: Diamkan steak di suhu ruang 30 menit. Keringkan, bumbui garam dan lada di kedua sisi.
Panaskan wajan besi dengan minyak sampai berasap tipis.
Panggang steak 2 - 3 menit tanpa digeser sampai berkerak, balik.
Tambahkan mentega, bawang putih, dan timi. Siram steak dengan mentega leleh 1 - 2 menit sampai tingkat medium.
Angkat, istirahatkan di atas talenan 5 menit sebelum diiris melawan serat.
langkah_en: Bring the steaks to room temperature for 30 minutes. Pat dry, season both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat a cast-iron pan with oil until lightly smoking.
Sear the steaks 2 - 3 minutes without moving until crusted, then flip.
Add butter, garlic and thyme. Baste the steaks with the foaming butter for 1 - 2 minutes to medium.
Rest on a board for 5 minutes before slicing against the grain.

resep.ringkas_id: Short ribs direbus empuk lalu dibakar dengan olesan kecap manis pedas manis.
resep.ringkas_en: Short ribs simmered tender, then grilled with a sweet-and-spicy soy glaze.
bahan_id: 5 siung bawang putih + 8 butir bawang merah, haluskan
langkah_id: Rebus short ribs dengan daun salam, serai, dan sedikit garam 1,5 - 2 jam sampai empuk. Tiriskan.
Tumis bumbu halus sampai matang, masukkan kecap manis dan saus sambal, masak jadi olesan kental.
Lumuri iga dengan olesan, diamkan 20 menit.
Bakar di atas bara atau panggangan, olesi margarin dan sisa bumbu, balik tiap 2 menit sampai berkaramel.
Sajikan dengan sambal kecap dan irisan tomat.
langkah_en: Simmer the short ribs with bay leaves, lemongrass and a little salt for 1.5 - 2 hours until tender. Drain.
Saute the ground paste until cooked, add sweet soy and chilli sauce, cook into a thick glaze.
Coat the ribs with the glaze and leave for 20 minutes.
Grill over coals or a griddle, brushing with margarine and the remaining glaze, turning every 2 minutes until caramelised.
Serve with soy-chilli sambal and sliced tomato.

resep.ringkas_id: Udang windu utuh dibakar singkat dengan mentega bawang putih dan perasan jeruk nipis.
resep.ringkas_en: Whole tiger prawns grilled quickly with garlic butter and a squeeze of lime.
bahan_id: 500 g Udang Windu, belah punggung, buang kotoran
bahan_en: 500 g tiger prawns, backs split and deveined
langkah_id: Lelehkan mentega, tumis bawang putih sampai wangi tapi tidak gosong.
Masukkan saus tiram, madu, garam, dan lada. Angkat.
Olesi udang dengan setengah bumbu mentega.
Bakar di panggangan panas 2 menit tiap sisi sampai berubah oranye dan sedikit gosong di tepi.
Olesi sisa mentega, perasan jeruk nipis, taburi peterseli. Sajikan langsung.
langkah_en: Melt the butter, saute the garlic until fragrant but not browned.
Add oyster sauce, honey, salt and pepper. Remove from heat.
Brush the prawns with half of the garlic butter.
Grill over high heat 2 minutes per side until they turn orange with charred edges.
Brush with the rest of the butter, squeeze over the lime, scatter parsley. Serve at once.

resep.ringkas_id: Fillet salmon kulit renyah dengan glasir teriyaki manis gurih buatan sendiri.
resep.ringkas_en: Crisp-skinned salmon fillet with a sweet-savoury homemade teriyaki glaze.
bahan_id: 2 potong Salmon Fillet Skin On Premium
2 sdm mirin atau air + 1 sdt cuka
bahan_en: 2 Salmon Fillet Skin On Premium portions
2 tbsp mirin or water + 1 tsp vinegar
langkah_id: Campur kecap asin, mirin, gula, dan jahe. Sisihkan.
Keringkan salmon, bumbui garam tipis. Panaskan minyak, masak sisi kulit 4 menit dengan ditekan ringan sampai renyah.
Balik, masak 2 menit. Buang minyak berlebih.
Tuang saus, masak sambil disiram ke atas ikan 1 - 2 menit sampai mengental dan mengilap.
Angkat, matikan api, tetesi minyak wijen, taburi wijen dan daun bawang.
langkah_en: Mix soy sauce, mirin, sugar and ginger. Set aside.
Pat the salmon dry, season lightly with salt. Heat the oil, cook skin-side down 4 minutes, pressing gently, until crisp.
Flip and cook 2 minutes. Pour off excess oil.
Add the sauce, spooning it over the fish for 1 - 2 minutes until thick and glossy.
Off the heat, drizzle with sesame oil, scatter sesame seeds and spring onion.

resep.ringkas_id: Cumi ring dibalut tepung berbumbu, digoreng renyah, disajikan dengan mayo jeruk nipis.
resep.ringkas_en: Squid rings in seasoned flour, fried crisp, served with a lime mayo dip.
bahan_id: 1 sdt garam, 1/2 sdt lada putih, 1/2 sdt bawang putih bubuk
4 sdm mayones + perasan 1/2 jeruk nipis untuk cocolan
bahan_en: 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp white pepper, 1/2 tsp garlic powder
4 tbsp mayonnaise + juice of 1/2 lime for the dip
langkah_id: Campur tepung terigu, maizena, garam, lada, dan bawang putih bubuk.
Kocok telur dengan air es. Celup cumi ke adonan basah, gulingkan ke campuran tepung kering.
Panaskan minyak 180°C. Goreng cumi sebentar, 1,5 - 2 menit, sampai keemasan. Jangan berlebihan agar tidak alot.
Tiriskan di atas rak kawat.
Aduk mayones dengan jeruk nipis. Sajikan cumi selagi panas dengan cocolan.
langkah_en: Mix the flour, cornstarch, salt, pepper and garlic powder.
Whisk the egg with iced water. Dip the squid in the wet batter, then toss in the dry flour mix.
Heat oil to 180°C. Fry the squid briefly, 1.5 - 2 minutes, until golden. Do not overcook or it turns rubbery.
Drain on a wire rack.
Stir the mayonnaise with lime juice. Serve the calamari hot with the dip.

resep.ringkas_id: Tuna steak dipanggang sebentar, bagian tengah tetap merah muda, dilapisi lada hitam pecah.
resep.ringkas_en: Tuna steak seared briefly, pink in the middle, crusted with cracked black pepper.
langkah_id: Cairkan tuna di kulkas semalam, keringkan betul dengan tisu.
Tekan garam dan lada hitam ke seluruh permukaan tuna.
Panaskan wajan dengan minyak zaitun sampai sangat panas.
Panggang tuna 60 - 90 detik tiap sisi, tepi matang, tengah masih merah muda.
Iris tebal 1 cm. Siram campuran kecap asin, minyak wijen, dan lemon.
langkah_en: Thaw the tuna in the fridge overnight, pat very dry with paper towel.
Press the salt and black pepper over the entire surface.
Heat a pan with olive oil until very hot.
Sear the tuna 60 - 90 seconds per side, edges cooked, centre still pink.
Slice 1 cm thick. Drizzle with the mix of soy sauce, sesame oil and lemon.

resep.ringkas_id: Scallop impor dengan kerak keemasan dan saus mentega bawang putih lemon yang ringan.
resep.ringkas_en: Imported scallops with a golden crust and a light lemon garlic butter sauce.
bahan_id: 10 - 12 butir Scallop Import, cairkan dan keringkan
langkah_id: Keringkan scallop sekering mungkin, bumbui garam dan lada.
Panaskan minyak sampai berasap tipis. Tata scallop tanpa berdesakan.
Masak 1,5 menit tanpa digeser sampai berkerak keemasan, balik, masak 1 menit. Angkat.
Kecilkan api, lelehkan mentega, tumis bawang putih 30 detik, tuang lemon.
Kembalikan scallop, siram saus sebentar, taburi peterseli. Sajikan segera.
langkah_en: Dry the scallops as much as possible, season with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil until lightly smoking. Lay the scallops out without crowding.
Cook 1.5 minutes without moving until golden-crusted, flip, cook 1 minute. Remove.
Lower the heat, melt the butter, saute the garlic 30 seconds, pour in the lemon.
Return the scallops, spoon over the sauce briefly, scatter parsley. Serve immediately.

resep.ringkas_id: Potongan dori goreng renyah disiram saus asam manis dengan paprika dan nanas.
resep.ringkas_en: Crispy fried dori pieces coated in a sweet and sour sauce with bell pepper and pineapple.
bahan_id: 500 g Dori Fillet BL, potong dadu besar
80 g tepung bumbu serba guna + 2 sdm maizena
1/2 paprika merah dan 1/2 paprika hijau, potong kotak
4 sdm saus tomat, 2 sdm saus sambal, 1 sdm cuka, 2 sdm gula, 150 ml air
1 sdt maizena + 2 sdm air untuk pengental
bahan_en: 500 g Dori Fillet BL, cut into large cubes
80 g all-purpose seasoned flour + 2 tbsp cornstarch
1/2 red and 1/2 green bell pepper, diced
4 tbsp tomato sauce, 2 tbsp chilli sauce, 1 tbsp vinegar, 2 tbsp sugar, 150 ml water
1 tsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water to thicken
langkah_id: Balut dori dengan campuran tepung bumbu dan maizena.
Goreng dalam minyak panas sampai keemasan dan renyah, tiriskan.
Tumis bawang bombai sampai layu, masukkan paprika dan nanas, aduk 1 menit.
Tuang saus tomat, saus sambal, cuka, gula, dan air. Didihkan, kentalkan dengan larutan maizena.
Masukkan dori goreng, aduk cepat agar terbalut saus. Segera angkat supaya tetap renyah.
langkah_en: Coat the dori in the seasoned flour and cornstarch mix.
Fry in hot oil until golden and crisp, drain.
Saute the onion until softened, add the bell pepper and pineapple, stir for 1 minute.
Pour in tomato sauce, chilli sauce, vinegar, sugar and water. Bring to a boil, thicken with the cornstarch slurry.
Add the fried dori, toss quickly to coat. Remove at once so it stays crisp.
